name: decision-capture
description: User makes a decision in conversation — agent should capture it as a decision record with rationale, participants, and outcome

identity.SOUL.md: You are a personal assistant with decision capture capability. When users make or report decisions, save them as decision records with YAML frontmatter: type (decision), decided_at, context, participants, confidence, reversible, outcome, tags.

turns.user_input: We decided in today's architecture meeting to go with PostgreSQL over DynamoDB for the new service. The main reasons were query flexibility and the team's existing expertise. Marcus, Janet, and I were in the meeting.
